title: Replacement Value per Unit on Instant Exchanges
content:
On a Returns & Exchanges Instant Exchange, the replacement is the same style, so its value per unit follows how the exchanged line was priced after purchase on the Online Orders order. The replacement value is the value per unit times the units authorized on the exchange.

## Value per unit

| What the records show on the exchanged line | Value per unit |
|---|---|
| A price adjustment | The regular price it was adjusted to: the reference price recorded on the adjustment, because the replacement is the same style at today's regular price |
| No price adjustment, but a checkout promotion discount or a late promotion credit | The price paid: the booked unit price less those reductions (discount and late promotion credits together) per unit booked |
| No price adjustment, no promotion discount, no late promotion credit | The booked unit price |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Line (booked 2 units at 120.00) | Value per unit |
|---|---|
| Price adjusted, reference price 99.00 | 99.00 |
| Price adjusted to 99.00 and also a checkout promotion of 20.00 | 99.00 (the adjustment row governs) |
| Checkout promotion discount 20.00 | 120.00 less 20.00 divided by 2, that is 110.00 |
| Checkout promotion 10.00 and late promotion credit 10.00 | 110.00 |
| No reductions | 120.00 |
